name: QrMatrixBuilder
src_typeComment: Builds the actual module matrix: finder/timing/alignment patterns, format info, data placement (the zigzag routing rule), and mask selection (ISO/IEC 18004 sections 6.3, 6.7-6.8, 7.7, Annex C/E). This is the highest-precision, hardest-to-self-verify part of the whole generator, since there's no way to camera-scan the output from this environment — see QrCodeGenerator's header comment for the honest verification caveat that applies to this file specifically.

src_members.sig: public bool[,] Build(byte[] dataCodewords, byte[] eccCodewords, int numBlocks, int eccLevelBits)
src_members.name: Build
